interpretation.mean: author posterior mean of labeled-new/total RNA fraction (NTR)
interpretation.alpha_beta_columns: posterior Beta-shape parameters, not synthesis or decay rates
interpretation.assigned_read_cpm_proxy: 1e6 * fractional GRAND-SLAM gene readcount / sum assigned gene readcounts within sample; compositional, not molecules/cell
interpretation.labeled_and_old_cpm: descriptive NTR-weighted read proxies; not absolute new/old RNA counts
interpretation.shape_screen: descriptive means; no inferential p-value and no individual-gene rejection threshold
interpretation.total_rna_kind: ribo-depleted whole-cell gene-level RNA; no matched nuclear/cytoplasmic or mature-only kinetic series
